Name: Big Ben - Golden Clock Sound
Author: empyreancharlie
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod plays Big Ben chimes if you have the Golden Clock installed on your farm. By default, it replaces the rooster’s crow at 6:00 a.m. It also chimes at 12:00 p.m. and 6:00 p.m., and at midnight it plays a special Big Ben chime to signal that it’s time to go to sleep.

This mod plays in all zones; you can configure how often and at what times you want it to play.

It’s written in C#, so it doesn’t require any dependencies.[/color]

Manifest.Name: Gold Clock Chimes
Manifest.Description: El Gold Clock de tu granja suena en lugar del gallo al despertar y a las 12:00, 18:00 y 24:00.
Manifest.Author: EmpyreanCharlie
